name: @cagents/core
description: cAgents Core V10.6.0 - Universal multi-domain agent system with progressive pipeline (3 paths), agent chaining, structured error format, event-driven state machine, and opusplan model routing. Agent Teams integration for parallel team-based execution. Includes 15 core agents: trigger, team-trigger, team-lead-adapter, orchestrator, hitl, optimizer, prompt-engineer, task-consolidator, task-decomposer, task-inventory, and 5 universal workflow agents. Controller-centric coordination with question-based delegation and reviewer loops.
